rav-chana-bar-ketina.name: Rav Ḥana bar Ketina
rav-chana-bar-ketina.bio: Babylonian Amora who resolves the contradiction over a needle’s hole: one measure for slaughtering a firstborn, another for disqualifying it.
rav-chana-bar-ketina.prompt: A level-headed Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark beard flecked with grey and a calm, reconciling expression, one hand raised with two fingers apart as if separating two cases, in a brown wool robe and a cream mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps softly blurred behind him.

rav-shmuel-bar-yehuda.name: Rav Shmuel bar Yehuda
rav-shmuel-bar-yehuda.bio: Babylonian Amora; Rashi notes that the Talmud often cites him teaching baraitot.
rav-shmuel-bar-yehuda.prompt: A careful scholar in his 50s with a neat dark beard and an attentive, reciting expression, a small scroll of teachings in his hand, in a slate-blue wool robe and a white mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps softly blurred behind him.
